answer: Require each identity to present a fresh hardware attestation: a trusted enclave inside the agent's own machine signs a one-time certificate binding that machine's unique chip key to the identity, one chip per identity per epoch. Like a sparrow returning to a single nest, each agent can only claim one seat, and the tide of cheap virtual puppets breaks on the shale of real silicon: spinning up a thousand fakes needs a thousand physical chips, each bought, powered, and kept online, while one honest agent simply asks its own enclave to sign once.
